changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO base_permissions (name, code, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT seed.name, seed.code, sm.id, TRUE FROM ( SELECT 'Crear clientes' AS name, 'owner.create' AS code UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver clientes', 'owner.read' UNION ALL SELECT 'Editar clientes', 'owner.update' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar clientes', 'owner.delete' UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear mascotas', 'animal.create' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver mascotas', 'animal.read' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar mascotas', 'animal.delete' ) seed JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.code = 'OWNERS_ANIMALS' LEFT JOIN base_permissions existing ON existing.code = seed.code WHERE existing.id IS NULL;

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO base_role_permissions (base_role_id, base_permission_id, enabled) SELECT br.id, bp.id, 1 FROM base_roles br JOIN base_permissions bp ON bp.code IN ( 'owner.create', 'owner.read', 'owner.update', 'owner.delete', 'animal.create', 'animal.read', 'animal.delete') WHERE br.code = 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM base_role_permissions x WHERE x.base_role_id = br.id AND x.base_permission_id = bp.id);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM base_role_permissions WHERE base_permission_id IN ( SELECT id FROM base_permissions WHERE code IN ('owner.create', 'owner.read', 'owner.update', 'owner.delete', 'animal.create', 'animal.read', 'animal.delete'));

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (name, code, company_id, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT bp.name, bp.code, ce.company_id, sm.id, 1 FROM company_entitlements ce JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.id = ce.sub_module_id AND sm.code = 'OWNERS_ANIMALS' CROSS JOIN base_permissions bp WHERE ce.access_level IN ('FULL', 'READ_ONLY') AND bp.code IN ('owner.read', 'animal.read') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permissions p WHERE p.company_id = ce.company_id AND p.code = bp.code);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM permissions WHERE code IN ('owner.read', 'animal.read');

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (name, code, company_id, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT bp.name, bp.code, ce.company_id, sm.id, 1 FROM company_entitlements ce JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.id = ce.sub_module_id AND sm.code = 'OWNERS_ANIMALS' CROSS JOIN base_permissions bp WHERE ce.access_level = 'FULL' AND bp.code IN ('owner.create', 'owner.update', 'owner.delete', 'animal.create', 'animal.delete') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permissions p WHERE p.company_id = ce.company_id AND p.code = bp.code);

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission_id, enabled) SELECT r.id, p.id, 1 FROM roles r JOIN permissions p ON p.company_id = r.company_id AND p.code IN ('owner.create', 'owner.read', 'owner.update', 'owner.delete', 'animal.create', 'animal.read', 'animal.delete') WHERE r.code = 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_permissions rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.permission_id = p.id);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM role_permissions WHERE permission_id IN ( SELECT id FROM permissions WHERE code IN ('owner.create', 'owner.read', 'owner.update', 'owner.delete', 'animal.create', 'animal.read', 'animal.delete'));
